description: A curly-haired child with brown ringlets, in a dark green velvet suit with white lace collar and cuffs, looks up at a single soap bubble drifting above a clay pipe held in one hand. In front of the child on a wooden table sit a ceramic bowl of soapy water and an amber bar of soap, with a cracked terracotta pot and a green plant at the right edge. The background is a dark, painterly brown-black wall. No text, frame or border is visible, and the scene is calm and non-graphic.
